name: promptman
description: Local-first desktop app for AI prompts, agent skills, and teams
author: OFX Labs

scripts.build: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && pnpm build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js
scripts.build:mac: pnpm build:next && node scripts/prune-standalone.js && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --mac --publish never
scripts.build:mac:unsigned: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --mac --publish never --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:win: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --win --publish never
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --mac --win --publish never
scripts.publish:mac: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --mac --publish always
scripts.publish:win: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --win --publish always
scripts.publish:all: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/electron-builder-with-date.js --mac --win --publish always
scripts.publish:oss:mac: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/publish-to-oss.js --mac
scripts.publish:oss:win: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/publish-to-oss.js --win
scripts.publish:oss:all: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/publish-to-oss.js --mac --win
scripts.release:oss:mac: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm run publish:oss:mac
scripts.release:oss:win: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm run publish:oss:win
scripts.release:oss:all: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm run publish:oss:all
scripts.publish:github:mac: pnpm build:next && node scripts/prune-standalone.js && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/prefetch-dmgbuild.js && node scripts/publish-to-github.js --mac
scripts.publish:github:win: pnpm build:next && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/publish-to-github.js --win
scripts.publish:github:all: pnpm build:next && node scripts/prune-standalone.js && pnpm flatten-standalone && pnpm copy-static && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-splash.js && node scripts/prefetch-dmgbuild.js --all && node scripts/publish-to-github.js --mac --win
scripts.release:github:mac: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm run publish:github:mac
scripts.release:github:win: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm run publish:github:win
scripts.release:github:all: pnpm exec dotenv -e .env -- pnpm run publish:github:all
